**Not ready to publish. One change needed.**

**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "the Christmas blend is back" | Allowed (new arrival / product fact) |
| "Black tea, orange peel, cinnamon and a little clove" | Allowed (ingredients) |
| "back in the shop from today" | Allowed (new arrival) |
| "selling fast" | **Unsupported.** No sales data supplied, and it works as scarcity pressure. |

**Slop check:** No ban-list words, no em-dashes, no exclamation points, no rhetorical opener, and the first sentence carries the news. Nothing to change.

**Fix:** Cut "selling fast". If stock really is low, give the real figure (for example "under 100 tins left") and I can add it, but I can't invent one.

**Suggested version:**

> Quick one this week: the Christmas blend is back. Black tea, orange peel, cinnamon and a little clove. It's back in the shop from today.
